findings.message: 19.P3.daemon-soak-runner requires Box fault visibility for unresolved conflicts and a resulting Box failure report for semantic integration refusal. Production harvests and terminals these failures without enqueueing either report. The contract explicitly specifies runner-side filing only for the mechanical conflict; supplying the other required reports would invent an unspecified producer or require unfenced engine changes.
findings.paved_road: Harden 19.P3.daemon-soak-runner to specify harvest-derived runner-side Box filing for both failure cases, or add a predecessor ticket implementing their production emitter with an earned engine fence.
